bootstrap.method: paired cluster bootstrap (series resampled with replacement, one shared draw per replication), percentile 95% CI over series x scored test origins
bootstrap.unit: series cluster x scored test origins

candidate_comparison.method: pooled MAE over series x scored test origins x all horizons; gaps carry a 95% paired cluster bootstrap CI over series (negative diff = candidate better)

_multistep.champion_definition: per-series routing: sparse (ADI>=1.32) series -> best candidate among the statistical methods (zero/seasonal_naive/Croston/SBA/TSB + the wave-22 ma_28/ADIDA pair) + the six peak-capable ML candidates on the selection origins; smooth/erratic -> best among direct_hgb + the same ML pool

cost_assumptions.cost_basis: per scored cell (series x test origin x horizon)

decision_metric.label: order-up-to policy simulation — cost assumptions documented, no savings claims

cost_assumptions.cost_basis: per scored cell (series x test origin x horizon day); assumption, not measured

newsvendor.label: newsvendor order-quantile cost — documented cost assumptions, no savings claims

order_definition.floor: q-quantile of the seasonal-naive empirical distribution: the training-window demand on the target day's weekday
order_definition.routed_dense: q-quantile of the committed p10/p50/p90 learner band ladder (linear interpolation; linear extrapolation above p90), zero-clipped
order_definition.routed_sparse: q-quantile of the training history up to the origin (the existing sparse ladder machinery)

demand_classes.method: Syntetos-Boylan quadrants on ADI and CV^2 over the full panel

_multistep.headline_claim: champion 'routed' pooled test MAE 7.47 vs floor 'seasonal_naive' 11.51 — rmae 0.649 (relative MAE vs the seasonal-naive floor; < 1 beats the floor)

origins.cap_note: weekly origins, capped at 20 by dropping the oldest (exact weekly cadence kept) for runtime; the window starts the day AFTER the origin (no embargo gap)

peak_capable_candidates.ensemble_convex: per-series convex blend w x routed + (1 - w) x best_ml (w in {0, 0.1, ..., 1}, best_ml = the per-series best ML candidate, both chosen on the selection origins; no refits)
peak_capable_candidates.hgb_tweedie: HGBRegressor with the compound-Poisson tweedie deviance (variance power 1.5); lr/depth/leaves tuned on the selection origins via a seeded capped Optuna study (hpo.tune_multistep_tweedie)
peak_capable_candidates.hurdle_hgb: per-h two-stage HGB: log-loss classifier for P(sale) + HGB on log1p(non-zero sizes); point = p_hat x (exp(y_reg) - 1), zero-corrected on the selection origins (identity / scalar / isotonic — whichever wins there)
peak_capable_candidates.hurdle_lgbm: the two-stage hurdle on LightGBM halves (classifier x log1p-size regressor), same raw point math and the same selection-origin zero-correction as hurdle_hgb
peak_capable_candidates.lgbm_poisson: global LightGBM with the poisson count objective — same features, same tuning contract as lgbm_tweedie
peak_capable_candidates.lgbm_tweedie: global LightGBM with the tweedie objective (variance power 1.5), series identity as hi/lo categoricals; lr/leaves/min_child_samples tuned on the selection origins via a seeded capped Optuna study (hpo.tune_multistep_lgbm)
peak_capable_candidates.peak_weighted_hgb: the HGB hurdle pair fit with sample weights 2-3 on each series' top-decile demand days; the weight is chosen on the selection origins, then the same zero-correction applies

bootstrap.method: paired cluster bootstrap over series (windows of a sampled series enter together), percentile 95% CI

peak_capture.definition: per scored window (series x test origin) over the scored h-lattice days: peak_mae = MAE on the window's top-decile-by-actual demand days (k = max(1, ceil(0.1 x 14)) = 2); peak_recall = share of the window's top-5 actual days whose day ranks in the forecast's own top-5

post_processing_candidates.routed_reconciled: hierarchy anchoring of the routed forecast (comparison-only, never in the routing pool): per country block the anchor is the seasonal-naive forecast of the country's aggregated demand on the target day; the discrepancy is allocated to member series proportionally to their routed forecast (fallback: training-window means; then no adjustment)

rmae.definition: rmae = candidate pooled MAE / seasonal_naive floor pooled MAE over the same scored cells; < 1 = beats the floor (the floor's rmae is 1.0 by construction)

rmsse.definition: M5-style RMSSE per (series x scored origin) unit: numerator = MSE of the candidate over the unit's scored horizon days, denominator = in-sample MSE of the one-step seasonal-naive-7 over the unit's training window; averaged over units (zero-scale units excluded); wrmsse weights by training-window volume

cost_assumptions.order_rule: order = max(pred + q_level(residuals on selection origins), 0) per series and routing arm

cost_aware.label: cost-aware routing — per-series pick minimises summed newsvendor cost on the selection origins (documented cost assumptions, no savings claims)

ensemble.definition: per series: pred = w * routed + (1 - w) * best_ml with best_ml = the ML_SPARSE candidate of lowest summed |error| on the selection origins; w in {0, 0.1, ..., 1} minimises the same selection loss — no refits, test origins never read

hurdle_correction.note: identity/scalar/isotonic compared on the selection origins only; the winner per hurdle candidate is applied to all origins; a series of all-zero training windows has no correction candidate (raw p̂=0)

peak_weight_choice.definition: pooled MAE of each raw weight variant over the selection origins' cells; the winner is applied to all origins (then zero-corrected)

routing.rule: per-series routing on the selection origins ONLY: sparse (ADI >= 1.32) series choose among zero/seasonal_naive/Croston/SBA/TSB/ma_28/adida_sba/adida_tsb plus the six peak-capable ML candidates; smooth/erratic series choose among direct_hgb plus the same ML pool

_multistep.track_note: PRIMARY multi-step headline. The per-model blocks above are the retained frozen nowcast (one-day-ahead) track, rolling_origin_holdout_v1 — valid but never mixed into the multi-step leaderboard. Each multi-step row is a TRUE horizon-h forecast issued at the origin (no actual within h days of the target is referenced).

bootstrap.method: cluster bootstrap over series (one shared index draw per replication across candidates), percentile 95% CI

win_rates.definition: per series and horizon: beats-floor = the series' summed |error| over the scored test origins at that h is strictly below the seasonal_naive floor's; win_rate = the share of series in the class beating the floor; 95% CI = percentile interval of a cluster bootstrap over series (one shared index draw per replication across candidates)
